text:
Maria Ortiz: FYI — quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. I want to lock owners/timelines for the autoscale/quota fixes and surface any recurring pattern notes. Short thread pls.
Jon Park: +1. I can take scheduler tuning items if no objections.
Kevin Liu: I’ll own quota changes with finance sign-off.
Maria Ortiz: Perfect. Rough agenda: 1) quota guardrail + backstop, 2) scheduler threshold tuning and pod packing, 3) headroom plan & validation tests, 4) recurring surge detection heuristics.
Chris Patel: I think the surge detection needs a small eval: currently we trigger on 90th pct token rate which catches big spikes but misses slow ramps.
Sarah Nguyen: Agreed. We should test with the 48h ramp traffic pattern from the replay harness.
Jon Park: For scheduler tuning I propose patches: adjust node_min to 20%, lower preempt threshold, and add a short smoothing window (30s). I’ll put a diff in the PR.
Maria Ortiz: Can you add estimated perf impact (latency + cost) in the PR description? Want clear rollback signal.
Jon Park: Yep. I’ll include a perf table and a smoke test: `./tools/smoke_autoscale.sh --nodes 4 --ramp 600`.
Devon (ops-bot): Reminder created: "autoscale-scheduler-pr" assigned to Jon Park, due 2024-12-03 18:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/tasks/AS-342
Kevin Liu: Quota change plan: increase user-tier GPU quota by 12% for burst windows, with a hard cap and automated cooldown. Need finance approval for incremental spend.
Maria Ortiz: Kevin, can you draft the approval request and the monitoring query to ensure we don't exceed headroom during ramp? Something like:
```
SELECT avg(gpu_util) FROM infra.metrics WHERE cluster='prod' AND minute >= now()-10m
```
and an alert if avg(gpu_util) > 85% for 5m.
Kevin Liu: Will do. I’ll also add a scheduled budget check daily and tag it to the commit.
Chris Patel: On validation tests: I can run synthetic traffic and validate both KV cache hit rates and scheduler response. I’ll run the 2h test on staging Wed morning and post results.
Sarah Nguyen: I’ll own the recurring pattern analysis. Plan: run anomaly detection on the last 90 days, surface top 3 patterns, and map to mitigations. ETA: 5 business days.
Maria Ortiz: Great. Let’s capture action items in a tiny playbook so on-call can follow without digging through threads.
Maria Ortiz: Action items (quick list):
- Jon Park — PR for scheduler tuning + perf summary — due 2024-12-03
- Kevin Liu — Quota approval request + monitoring query — due 2024-12-04
- Chris Patel — Staging validation run + results — due 2024-12-04
- Sarah Nguyen — 90-day pattern analysis + mitigations — due 2024-12-09
- Maria Ortiz — Draft 1-page operational playbook and post in #incidents — due 2024-12-05
Devon (ops-bot): Action items recorded in AS-342. Next reminder: 2024-11-30 09:00 UTC.
Jon Park: Small question — who owns rollback? If scheduler tuning causes regressions I can revert but need triage owner.
Maria Ortiz: Triage owner = oncall primary for that day (ops rotation). I’ll add an explicit revert doc in the PR with the `kubectl` commands.
Jon Park: OK, adding `kubectl rollout undo` snippet and a quick health check script.
Kevin Liu: Finance: I pinged @Sarah B. Waiting on cost window approval. Will update AS-342 when I hear back.
Chris Patel: After staging run I’ll post a short table: seed, qps, p95 latency, gpu_util, cache_hit. Should be <10 rows.
Sarah Nguyen: If I spot a recurring slow-ramp pattern I’ll propose a new heuristic: increase burst_headroom by 8% for sessions > 30m.
Maria Ortiz: One more: any infra changes must include a canary with <= 5% traffic and auto-fallback after 10m.
Jon Park: Noted. I’ll include canary logic in the deployment manifest + flag to disable.
Kevin Liu: Logging note: please add `gpu_pool` tag to all autoscale alerts so finance can slice spend per pool.
Maria Ortiz: Good call. Chris, can you add that to the validation checks?
Chris Patel: Yep.
Devon (ops-bot): AS-342 status: 5 actions, 4 owners assigned, 1 awaiting finance. Next check-in ping scheduled 2024-12-01 14:00 UTC.
Maria Ortiz: Thanks team. Let’s try to close the PRs and the quota ticket this week so we have playbook by early next week. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
